title: •Thrown Back
caption: •Thrown Back (V)
game_text: Deploy on table with 12 Defensive Shields from outside your deck face-down under here. Four times per game may play a card from here (as if from hand). Unless Yoda on Dagobah, each player’s ▲ or ▼ attempt (after the first in a turn) allows their opponent to draw top card from Reserve deck and/or activate 1 Force.
lore: Being sent to dispose of two Jedi is the battle droid equivalent of a really bad day at the office.
copyright: © 2001 LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 2001 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Unique. Banner STARTING EFFECT, no grabber box (printed base is a plain Effect). Slip prints ▲ and ▼ where the stub expands them; 'Reserve deck' with lower-case d as printed. No immune icon. Lore matches the wiki and the scan. Base scan only at 350 px; copyright line taken as the Coruscant SE-style form (2001, as the other Coruscant base in this project) — '2001 DECIPHER' just legible. Modern: Virtual Block 6 only (VB6 -pre, 350 px). Art: printed scan by its measured Episode I window (art.rect; the old trim zoomed in — Bill 2026-10-14).
